name: fillet-ends-on-a-hole-rim
why: A 2 mm fillet on a fin's root whose trim line on the floor (x = 3.5) touches a Ø5 hole's rim at exactly one point. Stock OCCT 8.0.1 builds it IsDone and BRepCheck rejects the floor face, whose outer wire meets its inner one with no vertex there; the vendored kernel patch 0007 has the fillet builder record the touch and cut both edges there, sharing one vertex. The volume must equal fillet-clear-of-a-hole's: a point contact removes nothing. Found by @FuruRok comparing OCCT with usd-brep (2026-10-13).
